slide2.title: What sCORE can do

It's not just about logging.
Your accumulated data changes tomorrow's practice.

features.title: Track your body's score in real time
features.desc: Combines sleep, fatigue, and training load into one number, so you know instantly whether to push today.

features.title: AI designs today's menu
features.desc: Just pick from your practice library. AI builds a pro-coach-level menu for you.

features.title: Detect injury risk early
features.desc: Detects fatigue, poor sleep, and declining condition, and alerts you before an injury happens.

features.title: Work backward from your goal

slide3.title: Does this sound familiar?
slide3.subtitle: Select anything that applies to you
checklist: I've missed an important race due to injury
I train hard but my times aren't improving
I can't quantify my own physical condition
I can't keep up a training journal
I never know if I've actually recovered from fatigue
Planning a practice menu from scratch every time is a hassle
slide3.resultSub: sCORE was built to solve all of these.

slide4.title: Better tracking changes your results
slide4.subtitle: Given equal effort, the athlete who tracks wins.
before: Only learn the cause of an injury after the fact
Planning a menu from scratch every time
Relying on gut feeling for your condition
after: See your condition at a glance with a score
Detect injury risk before it happens
AI builds a menu in 30 seconds
Your data becomes a weapon for the next practice

slide5.title: A message from the developer
slide5.message:
Throughout my years in track and field, I've been sidelined by injury more times than I can count.

Every time, I had to guess whether my fatigue had cleared or whether it was safe to push hard that day. And more than once, pushing too hard is exactly what sidelined me again.

If only I could have actually seen my body's condition as a number back then. If only I could have noticed the warning signs before the injury happened.

That regret is why sCORE exists.

I want even one fewer athlete to go through what I did. I want even one more athlete to be able to train at full effort.

I believe that staying on the starting line, season after season, is the strongest strategy there is.

support.title: Support & Contact
support.subtitle: サポート・お問い合わせ
support.emailCardBody: For questions, feature requests, or bug reports, please email us anytime. We typically reply within 1-3 business days.

faq.q: How do I delete my account and data?
faq.a: You can delete all your records from Settings → Data → Reset All Data. If you want your account itself deleted, please contact us at the email address above.

faq.q: Is Google / Apple sign-in the only option?
faq.a: Yes. Currently only Google / Apple social sign-in is supported. No password setup is required.

faq.q: How many times can I use the AI features?
faq.a: AI features (video analysis, meal analysis, and more) use a ticket system. You get 5 free tickets to start, and can earn more by watching ads, referring friends, and more. See the Tickets screen for details.

faq.q: When will the Team feature be available?
faq.a: The Team feature, which lets coaches and athletes share condition data, is coming soon. Thanks for your patience.

painPoints.body: Managing 20+ athletes by word of mouth and paper. Training continues without noticing who is worn out.

guide.articleTitle:
The Complete sCORE Guide
— From Training Logs to Condition Management
summaryItems: Training logs, condition tracking, and injury risk all in one app. Just 1 minute a day makes your body visible as data.
AI generates advice matched to today's condition. Get scientifically sound training management even without a specialist coach.
A team feature for coaches and advisors to check every athlete in 1 minute each morning — no more paper or LINE-based management.
guide.aboutBody1: sCORE is an app that supports injury prevention for track and field athletes through training logs and condition tracking. Launched in 2024, it's used by a wide range of athletes from middle schoolers to working adults.
guide.aboutBody2: "I want to log my training every day," "I want fewer injuries," "I want to manage my athletes as a coach" — sCORE solves all of it in one app.
guide.featuresSectionSub: A detailed look at how to use 6 key features

features.title: Training Log & Condition Tracking
features.what: Log distance, reps, time, fatigue, weather, and mood in one tap. Every day builds up into a chart.
features.tip: Just open the app daily and log your condition. The accumulated data becomes an automatic report for your coach.

features.title: Injury Risk Score (AI-calculated)
features.what: Combines sleep hours, accumulated fatigue, weather, temperature, and training load into a 0-100 injury risk score.
features.tip: Don't push hard on days the score is 70+. It makes your body's own signals visible as data.

features.title: Team Feature (for coaches)
features.what: Coach issues a code → athletes join. Manage every athlete's condition from one dashboard.
features.tip: Check on athletes remotely even when you can't be at practice. Absences and feeling unwell are reported right in the app.

features.title: AI Coach Advice
features.what: Based on today's condition, training history, and injury risk, AI generates advice on what to train or how to recover today.
features.tip: A partner that puts "I just feel kind of tired" into words. A morning check can prevent overtraining.

features.title: Share Cards (social posts)
features.what: Personal bests, streaks, and weekly load are auto-generated into stylish cards. Share to Instagram in one tap.
features.tip: Showing friends and motivating each other is the key to sticking with it. Join the sCORE Monthly Challenge to get noticed officially.

features.title: Competition Records & PB Tracking
features.what: Build up competition records by event — 100m, 200m, high jump, and more. A special effect and badge appear on a new PB.
features.tip: Your personal best updates automatically just by logging. Great for reviewing past records before competition season.

faqs.a: Yes. The FREE plan is completely free and includes basic training logs, condition tracking, and personal best tracking. There is no forced upgrade to a paid plan.

sCORE is built specifically for track and field. It supports the major events: 100m, 200m, 400m, 800m, 1500m, 5000m, 10000m, long jump, high jump, triple jump, pole vault, shot put, discus, javelin, and more.

faqs.q: How do I get started with the team feature?
faqs.a: After subscribing to the Coach or Team Pro plan, create a team from the coach dashboard and share the invite code with your athletes. Athletes can join the team for free using that code.

faqs.q: How is the injury risk score calculated?
faqs.a: It combines the last 7 days of training load, fatigue, sleep hours, temperature, humidity, and weather using a proprietary algorithm. A higher score means higher risk, and rest or lighter training is recommended.

faqs.q: How accurate is the AI coach advice?
faqs.a: It uses Anthropic's Claude (latest model). Because it generates personalized advice based on your own past data, you can expect more precise advice than a generic fitness app.
Yes. You can cancel anytime from the subscription management screen in the App Store / Google Play. Paid features remain available until the end of the billing period.
All training logs and condition data are securely stored in the cloud (Supabase). All your data carries over when you sign in on a new device.

faqs.q: Does joining a team cost anything?
faqs.a: Joining a team (as an athlete) is free. Once the coach subscribes to the Coach plan, athletes can use the team feature at no cost.

s1.title: Welcome to sCORE!
s1.description:
A training log and condition
management app for track & field
athletes. Let's walk through the basics.

s2.title: Quick Log
s2.description:
Tap "Quick Log" below the home
screen to record your fatigue and
condition every day.

s3.title: Check Your Injury Risk
s3.description:
We automatically calculate injury
risk from your fatigue, sleep, and
weather. Take it easy when the score is high.

s4.title: Stretch to Lower Your Score
s4.description:
Tap the "Stretch to Lower Score"
banner on the home screen to start
stretching. Your score changes when you finish 💪

s5.title: Free AI Tickets
s5.description:
Video analysis and AI menu
generation use tickets. We're giving
you 5 free right now! Watch ads to earn more 🎁

s6.title: Competition Plans & Recovery
s6.description:
In the "Compete/Injury" tab, AI
builds your training plan for an
upcoming meet or your recovery plan.

s7.title: Manage Your Workout Menu

Check and log today's workout
from "Home → Menu". AI-generated
menus are available too.

s8.title: Share Your Records

Create a stylish share card from the
top-right button on the "Records"
tab. Post it on Instagram and grow your following!
